units: e = 1 scaled units (lengths e^{-1/3}/L, energies e^{2/3}/L, L = 1); Lambda = lambda/e^2; general e: Gamma = e^{2/3} F(Lambda), E = e^{2/3} eps(Lambda)
model: H = -1/2 Lap_2D(r) - 1/2 Lap_3D(w) + 1/2 e^2 r^2 s^2 + (lambda/4) r^4, m=0, s-wave
method_A: psi-form 2D-radial FD (2nd order, h = 0.02/0.01/0.005 x e^{-1/3}, Richardson on ln Gamma), smooth exterior complex scaling in r (theta=0.45, transition 0.6), sine DVR in s (S=10, ds=0.14), ARPACK shift-invert with exact block-tridiagonal LU; Gamma from the discrete flux identity
method_B: CAP -i eta ((r-Rc)/(rmax-Rc))^2, 4th-order FD in r, odd-HO basis in s (w0=2.5), eta-trajectory (Riss-Meyer first-order corrected)
